title: Prototype is a process.
body: The first prototype proved the foundation of ASSAULT. It also exposed what needed to improve. That is the purpose of a prototype. No hidden development. No artificial perfection. Progress shown honestly. No hidden development. No artificial perfection. Progress shown honestly.

steps.title: Define
steps.body: Set the target: PE6-8 offshore casting performance focused on strength, recovery and control.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Produce the first physical blank and finished prototype.

steps.title: Load
steps.body: Perform static testing, destructive blank testing and structural review.

steps.title: Learn
steps.body: Identify opportunities in weight, recovery, guide construction and grip geometry.

steps.title: Refine
steps.body: Create the next prototype around evidence rather than protecting the first design.

steps.title: Validate
steps.body: Complete component, load, recovery and real-world testing.

steps.title: Produce
steps.body: Release the first Founder allocation only after the design is ready.
